newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar stocks spend quiet week in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Qatar stocks spend quiet week in narrow range.

text.p: Shares on the unofficial Qatar stock market crept higher in the week to Thursday in low volume trade, brokers said.
A formal exchange, the Doha Securities Market, is due to be set up before the end of the month.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 18-share index edged up 0.34 points to 129.23 points.
Among the week's gainers were market heavyweight Qatar National Bank which climbed three riyals to 545 and Qatar Insurance which gathered two riyals to 550.
Qatar Cement also gained two riyals to 305, while Qatar Real Estate crept up half a riyal to 54.
Trade in three shares -- Al Ahli Bank of Qatar, Qatar General Insurance and Qatar Leisure -- were suspended ahead of their company general meetings. Prices of 11 shares were flat.
